self_exclusion: This manifest excludes its own bytes.
normalization: probe-*.json are trimmed projections of live responses: lists cut to the first few items with a count note, long strings truncated, response headers filtered to caching/CDN/rate-limit related ones; the client IP in probe-geoblock.json is redacted. web-*.json and legal-tos-page.json keep only facts extracted from HTML. doc-*.md and us-doc-*.md are the Markdown variants served by the Mintlify docs (<page>.md).
source_policy: Primary sources only: docs.polymarket.com, docs.polymarket.us, official OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specs, Polymarket Terms of Use, official Polymarket GitHub repositories, and anonymous first-party API responses. No credentials, wallet, login or trading.
